annotations.title: Compare tourism figures of Italian comuni side by side

description: Compares 2 to 5 Italian comuni side by side in the same year: nights, arrivals, bed places, establishments, population, average stay and share of arrivals from abroad. Use it when the question is about several comuni at once and you have their 6-digit codes from cerca_comune; do not use it for one comune (use leggi_dati_comune instead) or to rank many by a criterion (use classifica_territori instead). `anno` defaults to the latest year with figures for every comune, so the numbers stay comparable; a comune without figures in that year keeps null values and `nota` names it, also flagging 2025 and later, when the counts changed scope. Fewer than 2 or more than 5 codes, a repeated code or an unknown one returns an error that says what to pass. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

anno.description: Year of the figures for every comune, e.g. 2024; default: the latest year they all have. A year outside their years with data returns an error that gives them.

cod_istat.description: 2 to 5 different 6-digit ISTAT codes as strings, leading zeros kept, e.g. ["058091", "015146"] for Roma and Milano; they come from cerca_comune.

name: confronta_comuni

anno.description: The one year of every figure: the requested one, or the latest year with figures for every comune; null if none of them has figures.

comuni.description: The comuni in the requested order, each with its figures of `anno`.

anno_capacita.description: Year of the capacity figures (bed places and establishments): the latest year published up to `anno`, so it can be earlier; null if none is.

arrivi_italiani.description: Arrivals of guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_stranieri.description: Arrivals of guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_totali.description: Guest arrivals (check-ins) at accommodation establishments during `anno`; null if not available.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

esercizi.description: Number of accommodation establishments in `anno_capacita`; null if not available.

permanenza.description: Average length of stay in nights: presenze_totali / arrivi_totali, not rounded, the same value as `permanenza` in classifica_territori; null if not available.

popolazione.description: Resident population in `popolazione_anno` (the latest year loaded, whatever `anno` is); null if not available.

popolazione_anno.description: Reference year of `popolazione`; null if not available.

posti_letto.description: Bed places in accommodation establishments in `anno_capacita`: the ISTAT total, or hotel plus non-hotel beds where the total is missing, as on the site; null if not available.

presenze_italiani.description: Nights spent by guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_stranieri.description: Nights spent by guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_totali.description: Nights spent by all guests in accommodation establishments during `anno` (one guest staying three nights counts three); null if not available.

provincia.description: Province (or metropolitan city) as recorded by ISTAT; null if not recorded.

quota_arrivi_stranieri.description: Share of arrivals by guests resident abroad, in percent: arrivi_stranieri / arrivi_totali * 100, rounded to one decimal; null if not available.

regione.description: Region as recorded by ISTAT (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

scheda.description: Link to the comune's public page on datituristici.it, to cite.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Notes in English, null when there is nothing to say: from 2025 ISTAT counts include privately rented holiday flats, so totals and non-hotel figures are not comparable with years before 2025 (hotel figures are); comuni without figures in `anno`; capacity from an earlier year.

title: Compare tourism figures of Italian comuni side by side
